lede: Franklin celebrates Christmas with a downtown holiday lighting day, Santa at the Johnson County Museum of History and Compass Park, and holiday movies on 35mm at the Historic Artcraft Theatre.
celebrates: Downtown Franklin packs its holiday lighting day into Saturday, December 5. The day starts with Breakfast with Santa at Compass Park, then a free Jingle Bells Express shuttle, a Live Nativity, face painting and the Dec-A-Tree Display at the Johnson County Museum of History, where Santa visits from 1:30 to 4:30 pm. The Lighted Parade begins at 5:30 pm and the courthouse square lights up at 7 pm. The Historic Artcraft Theatre runs holiday films on 35mm from November 27 to December 12.
lastyear: Franklin's holiday lighting has followed the same pattern in recent years, with the Lighted Parade at 5:30 pm, the lighting of the square at 7 pm and fireworks at 7:30 pm, according to a post by local officials. Radio station WJCP reported that parade entries were due by December 1 with lineup at 4:30 pm in downtown Franklin. The 2026 schedule from Discover Downtown Franklin keeps the 5:30 pm parade and the 7 pm lighting, with free activities across the afternoon.
facts: The Historic Artcraft Theatre at 57 N Main Street shows its holiday films on 35mm, with Elf, The Santa Clause and White Christmas in 2026. The Dec-A-Tree Display at the Johnson County Museum of History is open from 10 am to 8 pm on lighting day. The Jingle Bells Express shuttle stops at the DriveHubler.com Amphitheater, the Festival Country Visitors Center, the Depot Park Gazebo, Tabernacle Christian Church and Franklin Jewelers, according to the downtown schedule.
trains: The closest Christmas train for families is the Nickel Plate Express in Noblesville, which boards at Forest Park and runs themed excursions, including a holiday train, on 12 miles of the former Nickel Plate Road. The Indiana Transportation Museum ran trains from the same park from 1960 to 2018, and Rally has a page on what happened to it. The Whitewater Valley Railroad in Connersville has paused its main line trains after the 2026 flood but still runs motorcar rides and special trips. Check each host's schedule before you drive.

faq: When is the Franklin Christmas parade in 2026?
The Lighted Parade begins at 5:30 pm on Saturday, December 5, 2026, in downtown Franklin. The lighting of the courthouse square follows at 7 pm.
Where can kids meet Santa in Franklin?
Santa visits the Johnson County Museum of History from 1:30 to 4:30 pm on December 5, and Compass Park hosts Breakfast with Santa that morning.
Are there free Christmas events in Franklin?
The lighted parade and the Santa visit at the museum are free. Breakfast with Santa and the Artcraft films do not print a 2026 price, so check with the host.
What Christmas movies play at the Artcraft Theatre?
Elf plays November 27 to 29, The Santa Clause December 4 to 6 and White Christmas December 11 and 12, according to the theatre's schedule.
Is there a train ride near Franklin?
The Nickel Plate Express in Noblesville runs holiday train rides, and the links on this page cover it and two other Indiana train attractions.
